members.name: ContainerBackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the container background colour (container-background-color).

members.name: CssClass
members.description: Gets or sets the space-separated CSS class names (css-class).

members.name: ExtraAttributes
members.description: Gets or sets attributes that are not modelled explicitly. Populated on import and re-emitted on export so unknown/future MJML attributes survive a round-trip without loss.

members.name: Id
members.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of this block.

members.name: MjClasses
members.description: Gets or sets the referenced named MJML classes (mj-class).

members.name: Padding
members.description: Gets or sets the padding shorthand (padding).

members.name: PaddingBottom
members.description: Gets or sets the bottom padding (padding-bottom).

members.name: PaddingLeft
members.description: Gets or sets the left padding (padding-left).

members.name: PaddingRight
members.description: Gets or sets the right padding (padding-right).

members.name: PaddingTop
members.description: Gets or sets the top padding (padding-top).

members.name: VisibleWhen
members.description: Gets or sets an optional Scriban boolean expression. When set, the generator wraps the block in {{ if <expr> }}…{{ end }} so it only renders when the expression is truthy. This is a Tempo extension, not an MJML attribute.
